title: Large glyph / centered scale

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Relate symbol size to its field so the mark has intentional visual presence.
strategic_value: A consistent large-glyph relationship can make Instagram signatures recognizable across formats.
demonstration: The animation centers the gradient glyph, overlays axes, then diagrams its height as one third of the field height X.
practical_value: Use the displayed one-third relationship when studying this large centered-glyph treatment.

content_islands.name: Centered glyph
content_islands.spec: Place the gradient glyph at the intersection of the horizontal and vertical axes.

content_islands.name: Scale demonstration
content_islands.spec: Stack pale comparison glyphs above and below and label the active glyph 1/3 X beside the field height.

reference_purposes.Application: The sequence demonstrates a centered large glyph and its scale relation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The diagram labels the glyph height 1/3 X for this treatment.

ingredient.name: Large centered glyph
ingredient.role: Make the mark the dominant identifier in an otherwise empty field.
ingredient.application: The demonstrated glyph height is one third of field height X.
ingredient.scope: This large-glyph diagram; it is not a universal size for every Instagram placement.
